resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because every de-duplication candidate matched on face and was a true duplicate, with more than one of them already holding an Aadhaar and a match score above the false-positive threshold.
resolution.synthesis: The resident applied for a fresh enrolment, which requires their biometrics to match nothing in the database. All candidates matched completely on fingerprint and iris as well as on face, and more than one existing Aadhaar was involved, so the packet was rejected and the duplicate records were suspended with the oldest left active. The resident already has an Aadhaar and the surplus records must be resolved through the Regional Office.
